items.name: ui
items.title: Chelone UI Primitives
items.description: The shadcn/ui primitive layer Chelone components compose (button, card, dialog, field, sidebar, table, …), shipped verbatim so consumers can install a single primitive or the whole set.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: admin
items.title: Chelone Admin
items.description: The Chelone admin component surface (Admin, List, Edit, DataTable, TextField, TextInput, the auth pages, layout, buttons, fields, inputs, and views) wired onto the @chelone/vue composables. Granularizes so each component installs on its own.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: style-chelone
items.title: Chelone
items.description: Chelone's base configuration: the vanilla shadcn New York style with the neutral base color, Lucide icons, and CSS-variable theming. Install first to set sensible components.json defaults, then add Chelone components.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>
